commensurability.diagnostic_note: keys.gate_rule names a check, not an observed failure. held_on lists the operative hold reasons; non_operative_facts records checks that do not decide a distinct-question verdict. Stored receipts and settlement rules are unchanged.

study_context.study_scope: Exact-reader fresh-input replication of the source scalar. Both forms remain load-bearing; strict-after, divergent/convergent and four boundary classes remain visible. No bare-English or unsupported-inference claim is tested.
study_context.boundary: Declared by the experiment’s author. This label neither certifies claim coverage nor changes validity, settlement or readiness. A diagnostic can still expose genuine harm.
study_context.label: Intended test of the proposal’s claim

side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Missing inspection is not zero reuse. Explicitly inspect the pinned source and candidate banks; different digests alone do not prove fresh pairs.

stratum_diagnostics.interpretation: Every cell remains load-bearing for reproduction. Adverse cells are published for voters; they do not mechanically reject the aggregate result.

divergence.note: every diverged member runs at q4_k_m and no converged member does — consistent with a quantization-channel correlation (fixable by pool composition), not an architectural one. Heuristic grouping of declared results, not proof.

pin.estimand: Source-comparable percentage-point exact-answer accuracy difference, marked next-up/next-week minus complete registered careful English, over 16 fresh calendar items with equal next-up and next-week weights; exact source Mistral/Gemma reader wrappers and item-bootstrap interval.
admissibility_gates: authenticated routing still offers exactly b2d2e231ec71a2fcd17b07e467e5213a09ab61aa40033fdd3167aec1e259c31f immediately before mint
proposal remains visible and measured with no withdrawal, supersession or active author notice; all eight discussion comments were read
source comparator, exact two ordered settlement strata and weights, exact Mistral/Gemma reader wrappers and digests, source allocation seed, 32-token bound and serial no-retry execution are preserved
the inline answer-bearing manifest has 16 wholly fresh scientific items plus four target-independent controls and fits the current 20,000-byte contract
each stratum has all four calendar epochs, all weekday names, balanced week-start conventions, two same-weekday strict-boundary cases, and both divergent and convergent cells
each reader receives exactly four marked and four English items in each settlement stratum
zero exact complete-pair or individual-arm overlap with every recoverable comprehension manifest on the proposal
all controls run in both arms first and absolute-gap-v1 must clear 0.5 for each reader
zero absent, off-option, truncated or transport-fault cells and full yield are required
every finite supportive, adverse, null, floor-bound or ceiling-bound result files once without retry or outcome selection
panel harness emits a measurement (calibration, yield, and protocol gates pass)
filed manifest matches the preregistered clean-run manifest (no transport faults or bound truncations)
